newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU says vets TRW buy of Germany's Magna.
newsitem.headline: EU says vets TRW buy of Germany's Magna.

text.p: The European Commission said on Monday it was starting a routine probe into the proposed acquisition of Magna Automotive Holding GmbH by TRW Inc of the United States.
As part of the deal, Magna will also hold 80 percent of the shares in both MST Automotive GmbH and Temic Bayern-Chemie Airbag GmbH.
Magna is a German supplier of steering wheels, airbag systems and other related automotive components. TRW makes car safety systems, steering gears and vehicle electronics.
The Commission said in a statement published in the European Union's Official Journal that the deal was submitted for clearance on December 18 under the bloc's merger rules.
The rules at stake ban creation or strengthening of dominant positions in the EU. The Commission has one month from that date to clear the agreement or start an in-depth, four-month inquiry.
The agreement is part of a broader deal between TRW and Magna International Inc to form a strategic alliance to design, develop and produce automotive products. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
